tax.text: Downing says he strongly supports making the 2017 Tax Cuts and Jobs Act permanent to reduce taxes.
tax.quote: I strongly support making the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act permanent to keep more money in the pockets of hardworking Montanans.

immigration.text: Downing introduced legislation to expand mandatory detention of immigrants who commit property crimes and said such people must be removed.
immigration.quote: especially those who broke our laws crossing our borders, must not be allowed to remain

health.text: Downing says Congress should lower health care costs by promoting competition and transparency.
health.quote: Congress must prioritize reforms that simplify health care, provide transparency, and lower costs by promoting competition.

energy.text: Downing backs an all-of-the-above approach centered on fossil fuels and cheap, reliable energy.
energy.quote: Reliable and cheap energy means more money in the pockets of hardworking Montanans.

trade.text: McCracken criticized how Trump imposed tariffs as heavy-handed while suggesting the underlying idea may have had merit.
trade.quote: I think that the way that Trump enacted the tariffs was strong-handed and didn't leave a lot of room for our trading partners to adjust in a timely fashion.

tax.text: Miller said corporate tax receipts should rise and proposed restoring Medicaid funding and ACA subsidies.
tax.quote: I want to see that increase to 20, 25%.

trade.text: Miller said he supports free trade but would weigh national interest, opposing the current tariffs while treating tariffs as a possible negotiating tool.
trade.quote: we need to have free trade on the one hand, but we also need to look at our national interest

housing.text: Miller supports streamlining regulations and increasing the housing supply to address construction costs and affordability.
housing.quote: Second, we are going to have to understand that if we increase the housing stock, it is going to lower equity for homeowners

health.text: Miller called for repealing the One Big Beautiful Bill's Medicaid cuts and restoring Medicaid funding and Affordable Care Act subsidies.
health.quote: We also need to spend money on restoring ACA subsidies

tax.text: He proposes property-tax relief for qualified homeowners and first-time buyers, along with targeted capital-gains reductions for older homeowners who downsize.
tax.quote: Property tax relief to qualified homeowners, and to 1st-time homebuyers for the first 3 years

trade.text: Eisenhauer opposes tariffs, calling them an indirect tax that raises prices for consumers.
trade.quote: tariffs are an indirect tax on Americans that will inevitably be passed along in the form of higher prices for imported goods and business inputs

housing.text: He supports zoning changes to allow more duplexes, triplexes and multi-family housing in residential areas.
housing.quote: Zoning changes that remove barriers to the construction of duplexes, triplexes or multi-family housing in residential areas

schools.text: Supports increased resources for teachers, school transportation, school lunches, special education and public education programs.
schools.quote: I don't agree with the elimination of the Department of Education.

safety.text: Supports protecting and increasing federal funding for Montana law enforcement and first responders.
safety.quote: I will work to protect and increase federal funding for these vital services; I will make sure that Montana law enforcement and first responders always have the resources they need.

immigration.text: He supports enhanced border security to curb illegal immigration.
immigration.quote: things like enhanced border security to curb illegal immigration

abortion.text: Says Montana voters have expressed support for preserving abortion care rights.
abortion.quote: the people of Montana have spoken with a unified voice that rights to abortion care must be preserved.

health.text: He supports maintaining rural healthcare and Medicaid-supported services while rejecting a single-payer healthcare system.
health.quote: Montana’s critical-access and rural healthcare system must be maintained.

energy.text: Eisenhauer supported developing Montana’s energy and mineral resources to fund public schools and local communities while also protecting public lands.
energy.quote: Montana is gifted with a certain amount of energy that can be put into production and minerals that, if managed appropriately, can provide significant funding for our public schools and for our local communities.
